facts.fact: The vendor page states that a kitchen remodel costs $30,000 or more.
facts.quote: A kitchen remodel costs $30,000 or more.

facts.fact: The vendor page states that a bathroom renovation runs $15,000 to $50,000.
The vendor page states that a home addition can easily exceed $100,000.
facts.quote: A home addition can easily exceed $100,000.

facts.fact: The vendor page recommends that video walkthroughs of completed projects be two to three minutes maximum.
facts.quote: Keep videos short and focused, two to three minutes maximum.

facts.fact: The vendor page recommends posting on social media a few times per week to keep a home improvement business visible.
facts.quote: A few posts per week keeps your business visible without overwhelming followers.

facts.fact: The vendor page says to expect to pay $10-50 per click for competitive home improvement keywords in Google Ads.
facts.quote: Expect to pay $10-50 per click for competitive home improvement keywords.

facts.fact: The vendor page gives a hypothetical example in which one in twenty clicks becomes a $40,000 project, which it says makes the customer acquisition cost acceptable.
facts.quote: if one in twenty clicks becomes a $40,000 project, that customer acquisition cost is acceptable.

facts.fact: The page states a common guideline that established home improvement contractors spend 5-10% of revenue on marketing, with higher percentages for newer or actively growing businesses.
facts.quote: A common guideline is 5-10% of revenue for established contractors and higher for newer businesses or those actively growing.

facts.fact: The page states that brand building through TV advertising typically shows meaningful results after 2-3 months of consistent presence.
facts.quote: Brand building through TV advertising typically shows meaningful results after 2-3 months of consistent presence.

facts.fact: The page recommends reviewing marketing channel performance and adjusting resources on a quarterly basis.
facts.quote: Review and adjust quarterly. Marketing effectiveness changes over time.

facts.fact: The page says streaming TV advertising can place a contractor's business on premium networks including NBC, Hulu, and ESPN.
facts.quote: [Streaming TV advertising](https://adwave.com/resources/what-is-connected-tv-advertising) puts your business on premium networks like NBC, Hulu, and ESPN.

facts.fact: AdWave states that its streaming TV advertising to reach local homeowners starts at $30 a day.
facts.quote: reach local homeowners on streaming platforms, starting at just $30 a day.
